jobs.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview: Jimdo is becoming an AI-first company, and our People team is one of the first places where that shows up in daily work. We're looking for an AI & Data Analytics Partner to build the agents, analytics and workflow automations that make the People team faster, smarter and easier to scale. You'll take a process from "this is slow and manual" to a working, compliant solution in production, and then make sure the team can run and extend it without you. You'll also give leadership one reliable view of People data, so decisions rest on numbers everyone trusts. You’ll start with the People team, and the scope can grow to any other function across Jimdo. The team and who you'll work with: You'll report to the Manager Performance Intelligence and work day to day with the People team and our HR Business Partners. You'll also work closely with our AI team on standards and capabilities, with Finance and Legal on data consistency and compliance, and with our HR system and payroll providers. This is a remote role, open to candidates based in Germany, Italy, Spain or Portugal. What you'll be doing: Build a central reporting suite in Tableau that brings data from HiBob, payroll and compensation tools into one source of truth, with dashboards leadership actually uses. Own the quality and structure of People data, and use analytics to spot workforce trends, risks and process bottlenecks. Find the HR processes with the most friction and fix them with AI agents and workflow automation, from first prototype to production. Improve self-service for employees and managers with AI tools that answer the repetitive questions, so the People team can focus on the work that needs a person. Connect our systems of record and improve the data flow between HR and Finance, so there's far less manual reconciliation. Make every solution auditable, explainable and compliant, and set clear guardrails for responsible AI use. Run hands-on workshops and co-building sessions and write playbooks, so the team can build and maintain automations on their own. Your first months: After 3 months: you know our People systems and data flows, you've agreed the reporting scope with the People team, and your first quick-win automation is live. After 6 months: the central reporting suite is in use by leadership, and at least one AI-enabled HR process runs in production What you bring to the table: 5+ years in data analytics, AI and automation, or technical systems roles. 2+ years of hands-on work with LLMs, agents, prompt engineering and workflow orchestration tools such as n8n, with solutions you've taken into production. A track record of improving business processes through automation or system redesign, with results you can show. jobs.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. The role We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most. Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations. Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements. Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here. Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap. jobs.title: Build Your Own Internship – m/f/d (min. 6 Months)
jobs.description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role This is a full-time internship of at least 6 months at our Berlin HQ, and it is not a regular internship application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built. If you build with AI because you can’t stop, with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or anything else, show us. If your project convinces us, we shape the internship around you and your strengths. What We Want to See Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention: Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet. A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think. What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too. What Your Loom Should Cover The problem: what you solved and why it matters. The demo: show it working live, not on slides. How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it. What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that. What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined. What You Will Do Own a real project. Ideally it’s the one you showed us. You take it from prototype to something our team or customers actually use. Work directly with the team. You work alongside Product, Engineering, or GTM, depending on where your project lives. Ship, measure, iterate. You present your progress regularly and decide based on real feedback. How to Apply Paste your Loom URL into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional. You Might Be a Fit If… You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough. You think in impact, not just in technology. You show high agency. You don’t wait for tasks; you find them. You experiment constantly with new models and tools. You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus. You are kind and care about the people around you. What We Need Availability for a full-time internship of at least 6 months, 100% on-site in Berlin. A work permit for Germany. The Environment You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense. Next Steps We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us. jobs.title: Compliance Director
jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per wee

jobs.title: Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) - Agentur für Handelsmarketing
jobs.description: TEAMWFP ist eine Agentur für kreatives VkF-Marketing in Mönchengladbach. Seit 45 Jahren betreut die Agentur Unternehmen aus Handel und Finanzen in der Verkaufs- und Markenkommunikation: Prospekte, Mailings, Instore Design, Verpackungen und Kampagnen, für Kunden wie PENNY, Kaufland oder die Sparkassen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Beraterin oder ein erfahrener Berater als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde, mit eigenen Kunden und einem Beraterteam von fünf bis sechs Leuten. Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du berätst viele Kunden aus Handel und Finanzen, ohne mehrere Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen und ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde und koordinierst jedes Projekt vom Briefing bis zur Produktionsreife. Du vertrittst die Agentur in Abstimmungen beim Kunden und arbeitest dich inhaltlich in alle Projekte ein. Du bereitest Briefings verständlich für dein Team auf und erarbeitest kommunikative Lösungen, allein oder mit der Kreation. Du prüfst alle Werbemittel formal und inhaltlich, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und kalkulierst und überwachst die Kosten selbst. Du übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben der Geschäftsführung und steuerst das Beraterteam mit. Was du mitbringst Eine Ausbildung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Marketingkommunikation oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing. Erfahrung zählt mehr als der Abschluss. Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld oder in einer Marketingabteilung auf Kundenseite, Handelsmarketing ist ein Plus. Fundiertes Marketingwissen, mit dem du Kunden strategisch berätst und Leistungen verkaufst. Du greifst gern zum Hörer, behältst in vollen Phasen die Ruhe und bist sicher in Excel, Word und PowerPoint. Sehr gutes Deutsch ist Voraussetzung. Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet Ein Gehalt ab 4.000 € im Monat, je nach Erfahrung nach oben offen. Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: In Beratung und Kreation sitzen erfahrene Leute am Tisch, Entscheidungen fallen schnell und direkt. Viele Kunden und nie dasselbe: Vom Handel bis zur Bank übernimmt die Agentur fast jede Aufgabe, die ein Kunde stellt, und arbeitet bei den meisten Kunden nicht in festen Teams. Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht. Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing. Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar. Ehrlich gesagt: Als Schnittstelle hängst du an vielen Leuten. Vom Kunden brauchst du Infos, von Konzept und Gestaltung pünktliche Ergebnisse, und phasenweise wird es stressig. Der Tipp aus dem Team: von Anfang an die eigenen Grenzen setzen. Diese Stelle wird über JobMatches vorgestellt. Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) bei TEAMWFP in Mönchengladbach. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As an Electronics Engineer (Embedded Hardware & Firmware) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will help design and build the physical and low-level intelligence that brings our robotic hands to life. You will own the complete embedded hardware and firmware stack—from schematics and high-density multilayer layouts to the real-time C/C++ firmware running directly on the metal. Fitting multiple drives, high-density tactile arrays, and power electronics into a hand-sized volume means every decision is a tight balance of space, thermals, signal integrity, and manufacturability. You will work closely with the CTO and cross-functional team, moving smoothly between architecture, circuit design, and the lab to solve complex problems where physics meets code. What you will do: Own the hardware architecture. Design schematics and high-density, multilayer PCB layouts (mixed-signal, tight thermal/EMC constraints) built for modularity across product variants—not a one-off prototype. Build control hardware and firmware that can't miss a beat. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate actuator hardware alongside motor drivers for compact servo drives; write deterministic real-time firmware (C/C++) for control loops, timing-critical execution, limit monitoring, and fault handling. Choose the right sensor and make the data mean something. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate sensor hardware for tactile sensing and proprioception (position and force); design low-noise readout electronics, signal conditioning, filtering, and calibration pipelines to deliver clean, low-latency telemetry to the software stack. Ship rock-solid bootloaders and drivers. Build field-updatable bootloaders, low-level drivers, and secure, fail-safe update strategies across product generations—documented and reliable, not tribal knowledge. Build interfaces customers actually want to integrate. Implement and maintain fieldbus and hardware communication layers (EtherCAT, CANopen, Ethernet) aligned cleanly with higher-level software and robot controllers. Debug on real hardware. Support Cyber Resilience Act compliance by integrating secure boot, signed firmware updates, and hardware-level trust mechanisms early in the design cycle. Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics, Software, and System Applications—translating mechanical and control requirements into robust, deployable electronics. What you bring: A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field. 5–10 years of experience developing embedded hardware and firmware for mechatronic products, including at least one product taken into series production. An unseren Berliner Standorten schaffen wir Räume, in denen Menschen arbeiten, lagern, produzieren und ihr Business weiterentwickeln können. Doch WORKBOX ist mehr als Fläche. Wir wollen eine Marke und Community aufbauen, die Unternehmer, Macher und ihre Geschichten sichtbar macht. Dafür suchen wir dich. DEINE MISSION Du machst WORKBOX sichtbar – digital und vor Ort. Als Social Media & Community Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst du unsere Social-Media-Präsenz weiter, produzierst relevanten Content und baust gleichzeitig die Community rund um unsere Standorte und Mieter aus. Du bist nah an den Menschen, entdeckst Geschichten und verwandelst sie in Content, der Aufmerksamkeit schafft und Lust auf WORKBOX macht. Deine Aufgaben: Social Media & Content Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn Planung, Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Posts, Reels, Stories und weiteren Contentformaten Entwicklung neuer Formate und Ideen gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing Foto- und Video-Content direkt an unseren WORK BOX-Standorten Erstellung von Mieterportraits, Behind-the-Scenes-Content und Business Stories Community Management und aktive Interaktion mit unserer Zielgruppe Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unseres Content- und Redaktionsplans Beobachtung relevanter Social-Media-Trends und Übertragung auf WORKBOX Analyse der wichtigsten KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Followerentwicklung Community & Events Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung unserer WORKBOX Community Regelmäßiger Austausch mit unseren Mieter und Identifikation spannender Geschichten Entwicklung kleiner Aktionen und Community-Formate an unseren Standorten Unterstützung bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Events wie After Workbox, Breakfast Days, Barista Days oder saisonalen Aktionen Begleitung der Events mit Social Content Aktivierung unserer Mieter für gemeinsame Inhalte, Kooperationen und Aktionen Entwicklung von Ideen, wie unsere Standorte stärker zu lebendigen Business Communities werden Dein Profil: Du musst nicht seit zehn Jahren Social Media machen. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Content verstehst, Menschen magst und Dinge umsetzt. Idealerweise bringst du mit: Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content, Community Management oder vergleichbaren Aufgaben ein sehr gutes Gespür für Instagram und LinkedIn Sicherheit im Umgang mit Smartphone, Foto und Video Erfahrung mit Tools wie Canva, CapCut oder Adobe ist ein Plus gutes Sprachgefühl und die Fähigkeit, kurze, relevante Texte zu schreiben eigenständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Offenheit und Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen Interesse an Start-ups, Unternehmertum, E-Commerce, Handwerk, Design und urbanem Business sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse gute Englischkenntnisse Und vor allem: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Post vorgibt. Du siehst eine gute Geschichte – und machst etwas daraus. Was dich bei Work Box erwartet: Bei uns verwaltest du keinen anonymen Corporate-Account. Du bekommst Zugang zu einer vielfältigen Business Community mit spannenden Unternehmen, Produkten und Persönlichkeiten – und damit jeden Tag neue Möglichkeiten für guten Content. Dazu kommen: viel Raum für eigene Ideen und neue Formate kurze Entscheidungswege direkter Austausch mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung abwechslungsreiche Arbeit zwischen Content, Community und Events mehrere spannende WORKBOX-Standorte in Berlin Verantwortung statt langer Abstimmungsschleifen die Möglichkeit, die Social-Media- und Community-Strategie von WORK BOX aktiv mitzuprägen Über uns: WORKBOX entwickelt flexible Business Spaces für die unterschiedlichsten Anforderungen moderner Unternehmen. jobs.title: IT Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Agenten und KI werden fester Bestandteil unseres Gestaltungsprozesses im Lösungsdesign für unsere Kunden. Agentische Entwicklung ist für uns ein strategisches Ziel – und du gestaltest diesen Weg von Anfang an aktiv mit. Gerade deshalb bleiben solide IT- und Architekturfähigkeiten die entscheidende Voraussetzung – denn erst sie versetzen dich in die Lage, gemeinsam mit der KI die richtigen Entscheidungen über Vorgehen und Lösung für unsere Kunden zu treffen und deren Qualität zu verantworten. Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest aktiv den Entwicklungsprozess mit KI von IT-Systemen für komplexe Problemstellungen, nutzt AI-Coding-Assistenten und Agenten produktiv, um Komponenten, Tests und Dokumentation schneller und in hoher Qualität zu erstellen Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kollegen und Fachexperten des Kunden bringst du Projekte zum Erfolg. Du implementierst KI-Funktionen in Kundenlösungen – etwa LLM-Anbindungen, RAG-Komponenten oder einfache Agenten-Workflows – und integrierst sie über APIs und MCP in bestehende Systeme. Du entwickelst in agilen Teams service-orientierte Integrationsarchitekturen zwischen Versicherern und Vertriebspartnern und bringst deine technische Expertise direkt ein. Deine Qualifikationen Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung. Solide Kenntnisse (mindestens) einer Programmiersprache wie z. B. Java, C#, JavaScript. jobs.title: Werkstudent Betriebsplanung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei FlixTrain gesaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.  Zweck und Verantwortlichkeiten: Unser  Betriebsplanungsteam  sorgt dafür, dass unsere Züge pünktlich und effizient durch Deutschland fahren. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du das Team bei der Umsetzung und Pflege unserer Fahrplandaten – eine zentrale Grundlage für unseren Betrieb. Auswirkungen auf die Organisation: Deine Arbeit sorgt für reibungslose Abläufe im täglichen Zugbetrieb, beeinflusst die Reiseerfahrung unserer Fahrgäste und ermöglicht datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Unternehmen. Tools, Plattformen oder Prozesse: Wir arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Planungstools und Datenschnittstellen, wobei insbesondere Excel und interne Systeme zur Erstellung und Pflege der Fahrplandaten eingesetzt werden. Über  die Rolle   Unterstützung des Teams für Betriebs- und Fahrplanung im Schienenpersonenverkehr Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Fahrplandateien für interne Abteilungen und externe Partner Umsetzung von Fahrplanänderungen, etwa bei Bauarbeiten oder Störungen Pflege und Abgleich von betriebsrelevanten Daten über verschiedene Schnittstellen Mitarbeit bei der Kundenkommunikation im Falle von Fahrplanänderungen (z. B. Umbuchungen) Kontrolle und Aktualisierung von Haltestellen-, Strecken- und Zeitdaten Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem rund 10-köpfigen Team am Standort Berlin Über  Dich   Eingeschriebener Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende in einem relevanten Studiengang: Verkehrsingenieurwesen, Verkehrslogistik, Mobilitätsmanagement, Tourismusmanagement, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Geographie, Stadt- und Regionalplanung oder Informatik 6 Monate Verfügbarkeit für ca. 20 Stunden die Woche Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Mobilitäts- oder Verkehrsbranche wünschenswert Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel, Word und Outlook Sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Auge für Details Selbstständigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und Spaß an datengetriebener Arbeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Interesse an Verkehrsplanung, Zugbetrieb und Datenmanagement im Mobilitätssektor Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100% erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!   Was Wir Bieten   Reisevorteile : 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.   Arbeiten von Überall:  Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.   Hybrides Arbeitsmodell:  Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.   Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote:  Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.   Lernen & Entwicklung:  Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.   Mentoring-Programm:  Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.   Warum Teil von Flix werden?   Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. jobs.description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. jobs.title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco. Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way. No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business. What you'll do Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance What you'll get Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team What you'll need A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts) 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers Operational mindset Excitement

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Test Infrastructure
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company. We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites. About this role: As a Test Infrastructure Engineer , you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is: Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us! Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry! Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant! Key responsibilities include: Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop ( HIL ) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links. Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns. Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone. Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms. Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests. Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration. Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally. Must Haves: 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals ( OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP ). Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar). Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools. Experience containerizing applications with Docker. Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines. Nice to Haves: Experience designing or automating complex HIL / SIL testbed, signal conditioning, fault injection, or hardware emulation. Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS. Familiarity with networking simulation tools (e.g., network emulators, virtual switches) for testing data flows under realistic mission constraints. Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs). Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field. Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life

jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per wee

jobs.title: Founder Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: Who we are Hexa is a venture studio. Since 2011, we've built more than 60 companies, including 3 unicorns. Every year, our startup studio, Hexa Start, creates 12 companies from scratch, and our accelerator, Hexa Sprint, funds several dozen more. Each Start company begins with a CEO and a CTO we recruit ourselves: finding them is our core business. That's where you come in. 👀 The role Our partners bring the ideas. What turns an idea into a real company is the people who build it, so finding the right founders is Hexa's core business. That's your job: convincing aspiring founders to join us, walking them through a life-changing decision, and putting them in front of the right partner at the right time. Our marketing team builds and nurtures the reservoir of future founders. You turn it into a pipeline for each open role (say, a CTO for a cybersecurity project with experience in LLM-built attacks), run the search with the partner leading the project, assess, and close. Laure, your peer, does the same for each company's first employees. This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll need the business sense to read an idea and know what kind of founder it calls for, and a sharp eye for entrepreneurial profiles: you can tell a true entrepreneur from a strong manager, even when both look great on paper. What you'll actually do Source, hands-on: inbound comes first, but you roll up your sleeves and reach out to everyone who looks on track to start something, before anyone else does, Build a pipeline for every open founder role within two weeks, from your own sourcing, the marketing reservoir and our scoring agents, Own the founder scorecard with the partners and fine-tune it every quarter against real hiring outcomes, Interview, assess and close demanding, sometimes hesitant candidates, alongside partners and our CTO, Tell marketing and community what each search is missing, down to the event it needs, Act as product owner of our recruiting stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, AI agents), and call in agencies when a search runs short. jobs.title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
jobs.description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives. Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles. Pourquoi ce recrutement ? Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas. Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence. Missions Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes. 1. Enquêter Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs. Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A . 2. Dévoiler Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an. Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites . Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média. Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain : Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat. Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l' onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes. 3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier. Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne. Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances. Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires , toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes. Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen , Commission européenne , Représentation permanente de la France , Assemblée nationale , Sénat , ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés. Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp. Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG. Devenir à terme un vi

jobs.title: Senior Scientist — Organoid Model Development
jobs.description: Job description At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them — and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. We are looking for a passionate, hands-on Senior Scientist to expand Orakl's biobank to new indications. Working with significant autonomy and reporting to Gizem Altay, Principal Scientist, you will own the establishment of patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — starting with NSCLC and extending to additional tumour types — from tissue receipt and dissociation through to stable, well-characterised lines ready for downstream applications. You will develop and optimise robust culture protocols, ensure reproducibility across donors, and generate the high-quality biological models that power our AI predictive engine and our partnerships with hospitals and pharma. Preferred experience Must have PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, or a related field, as well as 5+ years of hands-on experience, including industry or translational settings. Proven, hands-on experience establishing NSCLC patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — including tissue handling, dissociation, embedding, and long-term expansion. Strong track record in primary tumour culture, including troubleshooting low take-rates, and donor-to-donor variability and other optimization including: media formulation, matrix selection, passaging strategies, cryopreservation etc. Exceptional wet-lab fundamentals: sterile technique, routine culture, assay development, and QC. Prior experience in building scientific direction, ownership of QC/characterisation strategy, and decision-making Demonstrated ability to independently plan, prioritise, and execute complex experimental pipelines with high quality and reproducibility. Strong analytical and quantitative data-interpretation skills, with clear documentation and reporting. Nice to have Direct experience collaborating with hospitals, pathology departments, or surgical teams on biospecimen workflows. Experience with drug-response profiling in organoids (dose–response, time-course, combination assays). Knowledge of molecular biology techniques and NGS workflows (WES, RNA-seq) for organoid characterisation and tumour-organoid concordance. Previous responsibility for managing CROs or academic collaborations. Experience mentoring junior scientists or lab technicians, and establishing lab standards. What will you find at Orakl Mission: Work in a cutting-edge environment, on the bleeding edge of cancer research. Growth opportunities: we’re rapidly expanding the scope of our work and you will be offered multiple opportunities to grow with it! jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. jobs.description: 🍇 About grape:    Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.   At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business. Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team. What you’ll do: 1. Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Backtest on the historical book and run models in shadow mode alongside human decision-makers, reporting where and why they disagree. Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review. Platform and MLOps Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data. Set up experiment tracking, model versioning, and production monitoring, partnering with engineering on integration. Shape the problem space Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems. Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, measurable modelling. Responsible & explainable by design Build privacy, fairness, and explainability into every model that touches personal or health data, working with compliance and legal on nDSG/GDPR boundaries. Models support decisions; accountable owners make them. Pricing, reserving, and claims work requires licensed-actuary sign-off, and any automation requires governance approval first. Collaborate Explain model behavior and limits to underwriting, claims, actuarial, and compliance teams. What you'll need: Strong applied ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series, and survival/duration modeling. Proven experience building models on real-world, relational, effective-dated data, including imbalanced outcomes. Fluent Python (pandas, scikit-learn, a modern ML stack) and strong SQL. Solid grasp of validation, calibration, and explainability (e.g. SHAP). Production MLOps: experiment tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring. Sound judgment on data privacy and modelling. jobs.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
jobs.description: Über VIA HealthTech VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat. Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat. Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf. Die Rolle Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus. In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht. Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem. Deine Aufgaben Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert. Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut. Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF. Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam. Dein Profil Must-have Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Syste

If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them. What you'll own You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means: Training and fine-tuning : embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data. Evaluation : offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse. jobs.description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere  Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.  Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid know

jobs.title: Model Risk Officer
jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own ter

jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! What you’ll be doing: Tool Operation & Processing: Safely and accurately operate cleanroom production equipment. Process Execution: Strictly follow established recipes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and safety guidelines to ensure consistent wafer-scale fabrication. Quality & Monitoring: Monitor tool performance during production runs. Perform basic inspections of the wafers and immediately flag any anomalies, defects, or machine errors to the engineering team. Accurate Documentation: Log production data, batch records, and tool usage clearly and accurately to maintain full traceability of our products. Cleanroom Maintenance: Help maintain a pristine working environment, ensuring workstations are prepped, materials are stocked, and cleanroom protocols are strictly followed. Your profile You bring practical experience from a high-precision manufacturing environment and possess the discipline to work independently in an academic cleanroom environment. Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate effectively across R&D and production teams. Organized & detail-oriented, able to document your work clearly and follow established procedures. You are a clear communicator who works well in a team and knows when to escalate issues to the engineers. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! As an Overall Aircraft Design Intern (all genders) , you will join our Central Engineering team and support across various Overall Aircraft Design activities. This role is a broad role, and you will perform different tasks to support on-going aircraft design and analysis activities. You will be part of our interdisciplinary aircraft design team and contribute directly to the design process of our battery-electric aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Support the analysis and comparison of battery-electric aircraft concepts across different configurations and mission profiles. Investigate how technology assumptions and key design parameters influence aircraft performance, energy demand, and overall feasibility. Develop and adapt computational tools to support aircraft sizing, mission analysis, and design trade-off studies.
