Document methods, assumptions, and results, and prepare clear visualisations to discuss findings with the engineering team. Your Profile: Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree programme in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Holding a Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Excellent programming skills (e.g., Python, MATLAB). jobs.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets. jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
jobs.description: Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken. Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou. Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten. Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers. Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten. Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers. Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten. Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus. Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie. Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities. Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot. Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie. Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten. Dit neem je mee Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Daarnaast: Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig. Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven. Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Dit bieden we jou Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden. jobs.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
jobs.description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Wat jij meebrengt Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy. Kennis van data governance, data quality

jobs.title: Medior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij

jobs.title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the role Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites. Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field. We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine. Your role You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to. What you will do Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production How we work Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document. Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before. Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design. Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you. Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field. Requirements You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor) You have built real hardware, not only modelled it You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours You understand design for manufacturing You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want Helpful, not required Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM) Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio Rendering and visual design Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking Benefits Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon Flexible hours around lectures and exams Compensation: €16–20 per hour 6-month contract with the option to extend Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sicherheitsthemen verständlich zu vermitteln und Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern voranzubringen. jobs.title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: DEINE MISSION Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig. Du postest eh schon jeden Tag. Mach daraus deinen Job. Du scrollst nicht nur – du weißt, warum ein Video durch die Decke geht und warum das nächste floppt. Genau dieses Gespür suchen wir. Der Großteil unserer Reichweite entsteht über Creator, nicht über uns selbst – und weil du selbst postest, sprichst du ihre Sprache und zeigst auf unseren eigenen Kanälen das Beste davon. Die Rolle ist global gedacht: Du denkst unsere Social-Strategie nicht nur für DACH, sondern sparrst dich dabei auch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads, zum Beispiel dem Head of Marketing in UK. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet. Deine Aufgaben als Social Media Manager Strategie, global gedacht: Du entwickelst unsere Social Media Strategie nicht im stillen Kämmerlein in München, sondern im Austausch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads. Du hinterfragst HQ-Vorgaben, wenn UK oder ein anderer Markt etwas anderes braucht, und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie und lokale Realität zusammenpassen. TikTok ist dein zweites Zuhause: Du erkennst Trends, bevor sie durch sind, und weißt sofort, welche Formate zu yfood passen und welche nicht. Instagram und YouTube bespielst du mit, aber TikTok ist dein Hauptrevier. Deine eigenen Kanäle, dein Anspruch: Du verantwortest unsere DACH-Kanäle und zeigst dort die stärksten Creator Videos, Produktlaunches und informativen Content. Qualität vor Quantität. Du sprichst Creator-Sprache: Weil du selbst Content machst, schreibst du Briefings, die Raum für eigene Ideen lassen, und gibst Feedback, das Creator tatsächlich weiterbringt, statt sie nur zufriedenzustellen. Du machst Markenmomente viral: Große Produktlaunches, außergewöhnliche Events und Creator Kampagnen bringst du auf Social und bist dabei auch in den Kommentaren mittendrin statt nur Beobachter. Daten sind dein Vibe-Check: Du planst im Redaktionskalender, schaust auf Watch Time, Saves, Shares und Hook Rate und machst konsequent mehr von dem, was funktioniert. Kein Soloprojekt: Du arbeitest eng mit Content & Comms, Influencer & Creator, Creative, Brand Activation, Performance und E-Commerce zusammen. Social ist bei uns nicht einfach nur ein Kanal, sondern das Betriebssystem. DAS MACHT DICH AUS Deine Qualifikationen als Social Media Manager Du bist selbst Social: Aktiv auf TikTok, idealerweise mit eigenem Content – zeig uns gern deinen Kanal. Instagram und YouTube kennst du ebenfalls aus dem Effeff. 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing – ob Brand, Agentur, Start-up oder als Creator. Food, FMCG oder Lifestyle sind ein Plus, kein Muss. Plattform-Fluency: Sounds, Duett/Stitch, Green Screen, Reels, Carousels, Shorts – du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was wo funktioniert und warum. Creator-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Creator ticken, und formulierst Briefings und Feedback so, dass sie auch ankommen. Analyse mit Attitüde: Watch Time, Saves, Shares, Hook-Rate sind für dich Steuerrad, kein Selbstzweck. Deutsch & Englisch fließend. WAS UNS ANTREIBT Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem. Verantwortung – Heißt für uns: Füreinander einstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und alles geben, wenn’s drauf ankommt. Professionalität – Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst – uns selbst aber nicht zu sehr. Wir sind offen, direkt und immer auf Augenhöhe. Kein Bullshit, kein Ego. Nur Team. Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue

jobs.title: HR Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Verantwortlichkeiten Agieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger HR Business Partner und beraten Führungskräfte strategisch sowie operativ in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen. Unterstützen und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während des gesamten Employee Lifecycles und fördern Sie eine positive Employee Experience sowie ein hohes Engagement. Steuern und koordinieren Sie HR-Initiativen in den Bereichen Talententwicklung, Performance Management und Mitarbeiterbindung. Gestalten und begleiten Sie den Performance-Management-Prozess, einschließlich Zielvereinbarungen, Leistungsbeurteilungen und individueller Entwicklungspläne. Analysieren Sie HR-Kennzahlen und Personaldaten, identifizieren Sie Trends und leiten Sie geeignete Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ab. Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Talent Acquisition Team und den Führungskräften zusammen, um eine hochwertige Recruiting- und Onboarding-Erfahrung sicherzustellen. Stellen Sie die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben, interner Richtlinien und HR-Standards sicher und beraten Sie Führungskräfte zu Best Practices. Unterstützen Sie organisatorische Veränderungsprozesse, die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat sowie komplexe arbeitsrechtliche und mitarbeiterbezogene Themen, um den nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg zu fördern. Qualifikationen Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet. Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer generalistischen HR-/People-Funktion innerhalb eines größeren, international ausgerichteten Unternehmens. Fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht, in HR-Richtlinien sowie in modernen Personalmanagement-Praktiken. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift. Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit HR-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit im Stakeholder-Management sowie im Aufbau und der Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen auf allen Unternehmensebenen. Analytische Denkweise und Erfahrung in der Nutzung von HR-Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Insights zur Unterstützung fundierter Entscheidungen. Hohe Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen, Fristen einzuhalten und sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im Team erfolgreich zu arbeiten. Über DP World Handel ist das Lebensblut der Weltwirtschaft, er schafft Chancen und verbessert die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. DP World existiert, um den weltweiten Handelsfluss zu verbessern und die Möglichkeiten für die Kunden und Gemeinschaften, die wir weltweit bedienen, zu verändern. Mit einem engagierten, vielfältigen und professionellen Team von mehr als 115.000 Mitarbeitern aus 159 Nationalitäten in 77 Ländern auf sechs Kontinenten treibt DP World den Handel weiter und schneller voran, hin zu einer nahtlosen Lieferkette, die für die Zukunft gerüstet ist. Wir transformieren und integrieren unsere Geschäftsbereiche – Häfen und Terminals, Seeverkehrsdienste, Logistik und Technologie – schnell und vereinen unsere globale Infrastruktur mit lokaler Expertise, um stärkere, effizientere End-to-End-Lieferkettenlösungen zu schaffen, die den weltweiten Handel verändern können. Darüber hinaus gestalten wir die Zukunft neu, indem wir in Innovationen investieren. Von intelligenten Liefersystemen bis hin zur automatisierten Lagerbeladung sind wir auf dem neuesten Stand der disruptiven Technologie und treiben den Sektor zu besseren Handelsmethoden an, um Störungen von der Fabrikhalle bis zur Haustür des Kunden zu minimieren. DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten. Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert,

jobs.description: Über Pertemps ERP Bei Pertemps ERP sprechen wir Ihre Sprache Recruitment zu verstehen ist eine Sache, Sie zu verstehen eine andere. Nutzen Sie flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und Remote arbeiten, eine Entschädigung für Reisekosten sowie Vorteile bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Freuen Sie sich auf ein Fitnessabo, Gutscheine und Ermäßigungen, Mitarbeiterrabatte, ein Programm für finanzielle Gesundheit und Programme zur Unterstützung der psychischen Gesundheit. Erleben Sie zusätzliche Urlaubstage, 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, bezahlte Elternzeit sowie Angebote zur beruflichen Bildung, Mentoring und ein Programm für interne Mobilität. Ihre Ausstattung umfasst einen Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy, ergänzt durch eine Cafeteria am Standort. Vergütung Das Jahresgehalt liegt bei EUR 85,000–100,000. jobs.title: Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) oder Wirtschaftsprüferanwärter (m/w/d) mit Aussicht auf Partnerschaft
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Mittelständisch denken, weltweit agieren – unser Ansatz seit 1935. Die Vielfalt unserer Projekte bietet nicht nur spannende Herausforderungen, sondern auch die Chance, sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei steht bei uns nicht nur die Arbeit im Fokus, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie sich wirklich wohlfühlen können. Bei Scheller & Partner legen wir großen Wert auf eine persönliche Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, in der Teamgeist und Wertschätzung großgeschrieben werden. Haben Sie Lust, den nächsten Schritt zu gehen, sich vielseitigen und spannenden Aufgaben zu stellen und gleichzeitig fachlich, persönlich und finanziell zu profitieren? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig! Aufgaben Ihr Aufgabengebiet Durch unsere interdisziplinäre Ausrichtung profitieren nicht nur unsere Mandanten, sondern auch Sie als Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d). Bei Scheller & Partner können Sie den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle sowie abwechslungsreiche Mandate übernehmen. Abhängig von Ihren Schwerpunkten, umfasst Ihr Aufgabenbereich: Prüfung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen Durchführung von Due-Diligence-Prüfungen, IKS-Prüfungen sowie Unternehmensbewertungen Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen Steuerliche Beratung Qualifikation Das bringen Sie mit In unserem Team legen wir großen Wert auf Zuverlässigkeit und Kollegialität – denn nur dann sind wir gemeinsam erfolgreich! Wenn Sie zudem die folgenden Qualifikationen mitbringen, passen Sie perfekt zu uns: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsprüferexamen (oder Voraussetzungen für Wirtschaftsprüferexamen erfüllt) und erste Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, mit der Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Sachverhalte zu analysieren und praxisorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln Engagement, Zielstrebigkeit und die Lust, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln Benefits Ihre Vorteile bei uns Ein erfolgreiches Team braucht die richtige Basis – ein positives Arbeitsklima, klare Kommunikation und Freude an den täglichen Aufgaben. jobs.title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen. Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir. Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise. Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit. Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst. Das bringst du mit Background Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst. Skills und Qualifikationen: Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl. Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern. Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus. Mindset Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen. Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten. Organisation & Ruhe: Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt. Gut zu wissen: Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) und wird vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office ausgeübt, so bist du mittendrin im Team und im täglichen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Deinen Starttermin stimmen wir flexibel mit dir ab. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. jobs.title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft. As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness. You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner. Your Day-to-Day: Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service. Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented. Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams. Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme. Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations. Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses. Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels. Shape the certification approach for the propulsion battery system in cooperation with Certification and Airworthiness and represent the ESS team in technical discussions with EASA, including Stage of Involvement (SOI) and compliance reviews. Own the integration of the propulsion battery system with the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the charging and ground infrastructure, including the definition and control of all associated interface requirements. Develop and execute the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system: identify patentable innovations, lead invention disclosures and work with patent counsel on filings, freedom-to-operate assessments and prior-art reviews. Own the PBS department budget, including planning, forecasting and cost control for personnel, hardware, test campaigns and external services. Select and manage key technology suppliers and partners, including cell suppliers, electronics manufacturing partners and suppliers of materials and components, ens

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations. Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces. Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase. Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures. Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies. Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration. Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements. Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities. Your Profile: Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems. Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration. Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification. Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus. Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight. Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus. Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial. Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. jobs.title: Electrical Systems Designer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings. You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle. The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team. Your Day-to-Day: Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU). Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods. Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system. Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability. Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation. Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements. Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals. Your Profile: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program. Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent. Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft electrical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset. Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, diagramming and drafting. Sound knowledge of aircraft electrical installations, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, assembly and inspection requirements. Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles. Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations. jobs.title: Talent Partner (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: At VÆRIDION, we're building the Microliner, a fully electric aircraft, and the battery technology that powers it. To make that happen, we need great people, and as our Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders), you'll play a key role in bringing them on board. As part of our People & Culture team, you'll own recruiting end to end for your positions and advise our hiring managers as a true partner. You'll make sure every candidate gets a process that is fast, honest, and personal. You'll also keep improving how we find and hire talent. Our goal is to ensure that every candidate leaves the process with a positive impression of VÆRIDION, regardless of the outcome. Your Day-to-Day: Manage full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, from screening to offer and closing. Understand your hiring managers' requirements and advise them on recruiting, including relevant market insights, realistic timelines, and candidate availability. Design and run sourcing strategies, including direct outreach, talent mapping, and networks, to reach passive candidates in competitive markets. Lead complex and cross-functional hiring processes, and influence hiring decisions with structured interviews and data-driven recommendations. Negotiate offers and close candidates. Maintain our ATS Ashby and keep data and reporting clean and reliable. Improve our recruiting processes, candidate experience, and employer branding. Your Profile: You have a background in HR, business, psychology, or a related field. You have 3+ years of recruiting experience from first conversation to signed contract, ideally in a scaling company or a technical industry. You can run a hiring process on your own, from screening to hire, and you are confident challenging hiring managers to drive better hiring decisions. You find people who aren't looking. You know how to approach engineers and specialists directly and get a reply. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and in conversation, and you keep candidates and stakeholders informed without being asked. You stay organised across many open roles at once and never lose track of a candidate. You work well with data and modern recruiting tools. Experience with Ashby is a plus. Fluent in English is required, German is a Plus. You enjoy working in an office-first culture at our Munich site. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security. Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft. Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects. Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports). VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delive

jobs.title: Head of Event Marketing
jobs.description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. Location: Remote USA Role Overview At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional and passionate Head of Event Marketing to build and lead our global events program. With more than 20,000 customers and a place on the AI 50, CodeRabbit is one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, and events are one of our most important engines for brand, pipeline and direct revenue. You will own a truly global remit spanning North America, Western Europe, Japan and the broader APAC region, with a multi-million dollar budget that is growing year over year. This is a builder role. You will inherit a strong core team, grow it, and set the strategy for every event we sponsor or host, from Tier 1 conferences like AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next and NVIDIA GTC, to local-market engineering leadership events, to our own customer conferences across multiple continents. jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description: Senior Account Manager About us SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings. Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life. About the role The Senior Account Manager owns and grows an established portfolio of customers, driving renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities while strengthening long-term relationships and accelerating software adoption. The role supports clients to optimise building maintenance strategies through our innovative solutions. With a consultative approach, the Senior Account Manager navigates complex sales cycles and ensures seamless migration to our latest software solutions, empowering customers to build safer, more efficient buildings. The role will require travel twice a month to our Newcastle offices. Key Responsibilities • Account Management: Build and nurture strong, strategic, long-term relationships with mid-market and enterprise clients, understanding their business needs and aligning SFG20 solutions to their strategic objectives. • Retention and Growth: Identify and convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities across an existing customer portfolio, while working with internal teams to strengthen retention and customer lifetime value. • Renewals: Proactively manage contract renewals, ensuring continued business growth. • Solution Selling: Tailor our software solutions to each client’s needs, positioning SFG20 as a strategic partner. • Product Demonstrations: Deliver engaging presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate the value proposition. • Migrations: Proactively support customers moving from legacy products to Facilities-iQ, communicating the commercial and operational benefits of the transition. • Contract Management: Manage contract negotiations to secure renewals while maintaining strong customer satisfaction. Balance customer needs with business objectives to maximize account profitability. • Adoption: Work closely with Software Trainers to maximize user adoption and ensure a frictionless transition. • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales (SDR/BDR & KAM), L&D, Marketing, and Product Development to deliver exceptional service and drive shared success. • Data-Driven Performance: Use CRM data to prioritise accounts, maintain accurate renewal and expansion forecasts, monitor KPIs and identify opportunities for commercial growth. • Industry & Product Expertise: Stay ahead of trends in SaaS, facilities management, and building maintenance to keep clients informed and empowered. Essential experience • 5 Years + Proven B2B SaaS account management experience, with measurable success against revenue growth and retention targets. • Strong background in managing client relationships, renewals, and software adoption with mid-market or enterprise segments. • Demonstrated ability to drive high-value deals, manage complex sales cycles, and navigate contract negotiations. • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate the value of complex SaaS solutions. • A consultative approach to account management, with a deep understanding of customer needs. • Ability to build account plans and tailor engagement to customer needs, renewal timelines and growth potential. • Experience using CRM platforms (HubSpot or similar) to track performance and drive engagement. • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively. • Curious, innovative, and eager to learn. With a competitive mindset and a strong desire to win. • Experience forecasting pipeline, handling objections, and delivering innovative solutions to client challenges. Desirable • Knowledge of Facilities Management technologies or CAFM solutions

jobs.title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
jobs.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🎙️ The Role We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager. This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity. tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework. In your first 12 months, you might: Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on. Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them. Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made. Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets. Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up. 🚀 Responsibilities Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence. Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit. Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team. Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a senior member of the Paddle legal and compliance team, reporting directly to Paddle’s Director of Legal. The Paddle legal team is well-respected and integrated into Paddle’s business. As a result, this role will require you to collaborate with other teams across the business, and advise cross-functionally, always with a view to empowering the business to achieve its goals while taking a long-term strategic view. The role itself will be broad and varied, with a core regulatory element. You will be delivering first-rate legal advice in a fast-paced dynamic environment, identifying risk and balancing common sense with your legal expertise. You will be an excellent generalist, comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will consider the longer-term impacts whilst also being able to react quickly to deliver level-headed, creative and context-appropriate solutions to ensure the best possible customer experience in the ever changing tech space. The role will be based in the UK but will be global in scope. What you'll do: You will support the Director of Legal in their duties and advise and partner with every team from across the business on a wide range of matters, including the following: Leadership remit : As a senior member of the team, you will work as part of a small team of lawyers in a wide range of legal work, including corporate and governance matters, administration of Paddle’s international branches and subsidiaries, negotiating commercial agreements, regulatory research and advising our product and support teams. Your duties may include supervising in-house trainee lawyers seeking their SRA qualification. Strategic commercial work : You will assist in the negotiation of strategic commercial contracts, including key supplier and customer agreements. Strategic corporate work : You will assist with the negotiation of strategic corporate contracts, including financing agreements. Regulatory advice (incl data protection) : You will lead on the identification and analysis of evolving rules and consumer regulations relevant to Paddle’s global MoR business model. We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance. We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change. We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo. The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are: Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A ⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️ Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Bij Strategy & Portfolio Management verbind je strategie, prioriteiten en resultaat. Samen met collega’s in strategie, performance, programma management help je ExCo en de domeinen om onderbouwde keuzes te maken en gericht bij te sturen. Je bouwt mee aan een team waarin samenwerking, een scherpe inhoudelijke blik en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Maak van data inzichten die ertoe doen. Als Data & Insights Analyst vertaal je interne en externe data naar dashboards, analyses en kernboodschappen die strategie, performance, portfoliosturing en ExCo-besluitvorming ondersteunen. V erantwoordelijkheden Je ontsluit en combineert databronnen en bewaakt kwaliteit, definities en herleidbaarheid; Je ontwikkelt en beheert Power BI-dashboards die strategie- en portfolioperformance inzichtelijk maken en ExCo ondersteunen bij onderbouwde besluitvorming; Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere analyses en kernboodschappen voor management en ExCo; Je levert betrouwbare inzichten voor de kwartaalreviews, op basis van maandrapportages en aanvullende analyses; Je verrijkt interne analyses met markt-, klant- en concurrentie-inzichten; Je verdiept inzichten met scenario- en oorzaakanalyses; Je signaleert trends, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en mogelijkheden om bij te sturen; Je helpt data- en rapportageprocessen verbeteren en ondersteunt waar passend andere afdelingen bij dashboarding. #LI-DN Wat vragen we van jou? Academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Data Analytics, Bedrijfskunde, Economie, Informatiekunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 5 tot 7 jaar relevante ervaring met data-analyse, business intelligence, performance management of managementinformatie; Aantoonbare ervaring met dashboards, rapportages en analyses, bij voorkeur met Power BI en meerdere databronnen; Ervaring met het vertalen van complexe data naar begrijpelijke inzichten en stuurinformatie voor management en besluitvorming. Daarnaast: Analytisch sterk: je brengt structuur in complexe informatie en herkent patronen en verbanden; Helder in communicatie: je maakt van analyses een begrijpelijk verhaal dat helpt bij keuzes; Samenwerkingsgericht: je begrijpt informatiebehoeften en stemt soepel af met uiteenlopende stakeholders; Kwaliteitsbewust en scherp: je bewaakt consistentie en maakt afwijkingen en datakwaliteitsproblemen bespreekbaar; Resultaatgericht: je plant zorgvuldig en levert tijdig betrouwbare, praktisch bruikbare inzichten. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardighed

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
jobs.description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.  We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours  Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. jobs.description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. jobs.title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
jobs.description: Over Nedlin Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Samen kijken we welke opdracht het beste aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en kwaliteiten. Het doel is om processen beter op elkaar aan te laten sluiten, handmatige handelingen te verminderen en de kans op fouten bij salarisbetalingen te verkleinen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren en in kaart brengen van de huidige processen en mutatiestromen; Het signaleren van knelpunten en foutgevoelige stappen; Het onderzoeken van mogelijkheden voor automatisering en procesverbetering; Het uitwerken van een praktisch advies voor een efficiëntere werkwijze. Om inzicht te krijgen in de prestaties wordt managementinformatie momenteel grotendeels handmatig bijgehouden in een dashboard. jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build
