jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen. Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt. Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd. Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging. Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen. Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken. Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen. Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening. Wat vragen we van jou? Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
jobs.description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: The role. We're hiring a Director of Decision Science to build and lead the team that turns Instructure's data into better decisions. You'll own the decision science function: the people, the roadmap, and the standards. Your team will run experiments, build causal and predictive models, and answer the questions that shape our product, pricing, go-to-market, and operating plans. This is a people-leadership role. You'll hire, coach, and grow a team of decision scientists, and you'll set the bar for analytical rigor across the company. You'll still be close enough to the work to review a model, challenge a test design, or dig into a dataset yourself. But your main job is making your team's work count, and making sure leaders act on it. You'll sit at the table with product, engineering, marketing, finance, and the executive team. When a decision is expensive, ambiguous, or high-stakes, you're the person who tells us what the data supports and what it doesn't. What you'll do. Build and lead the decision science team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a group of scientists and analysts, and own their career growth. Set the function's strategy and roadmap. Direct the development of predictive, prescriptive, and causal models that inform product decisions, customer retention, pricing, and operating efficiency. Raise the bar on how insights reach decision-makers, from dashboards and metric definitions to written recommendations and executive readouts. Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders. Say clearly what we know, what we don't, and what you'd do about it. Grow data literacy across Instructure so teams ask sharper questions and read results correctly on their own. Work with data engineering and platform teams to make sure the team has the data, tooling, and infrastructure it needs. Hold the line on ethical, privacy-conscious data use, including student data. Follow applicable regulations and our own standards, and make sure your team does too. Strong SQL skills, plus fluency in Python or R. Experience with modern data platforms and large-scale data tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark. A record of hiring well, developing people, and building a team culture others want to join. Comfort setting priorities in a fast-moving environment where the questions change and the data is imperfect. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission This is a senior role for someone who leads from both directions at once — deeply technical on customer engagements, and fully accountable for the growth and performance of a team of ML engineers and architects. You will report to the Director of AI/ML. You own hiring, development, and team health alongside leading complex customer engagements, shaping architecture, and driving pre-sales. Both parts of this job are real and ongoing. The right candidate will find energy in that combination, not tension. Your Assignment Leading Your Team Hire and build: Set the technical bar for ML roles on your team, lead or oversee technical assessments, and make hiring decisions you can stand behind. Build a team that raises the practice's overall standard. Develop people: Run regular structured 1:1s, provide candid feedback at meaningful milestones, and actively invest in each person's growth — whether they are early in their career or highly experienced. Manage performance: Recognize strong contributors and address performance gaps directly and early. Partner with HRBPs and the Director of AI/ML when situations require a structured path, and advocate for your team when they deserve it. Stay close to staffing: Understand how your team is utilized across engagements, keep the staffing team informed of each person's skills evolution and preferences, and ensure people are placed in work that stretches them appropriately. Strategic Advisory Lead ML assessments: Evaluate customer environments end-to-end — infrastructure, data pipelines, model lifecycle, and organizational readiness — and produce recommendations that drive executive decisions and open the door to the next engagement. Shape architecture: Serve as the senior technical authority on engagements, setting architectural direction, ensuring technical quality across the team, and making the calls that matter when tradeoffs are hard. Advise on ML operations: Help customers build ML systems they can actually own and sustain — translating MLOps, LLMOps, and production monitoring complexity into standards their engineering teams can execute and their leadership can act on. Drive pre-sales: Partner with sales and solutions teams during scoping and proposal phases, contributing the technical depth needed to scope work accurately and give prospects confidence in Caylent's ability to deliver. Hands-On Delivery Lead engagements end-to-end: Drive architecture and solution design from kickoff through delivery — setting technical direction, unblocking the team on hard problems, and ensuring the work meets Caylent's quality standards. Own the technical relationship: Depending on the engagement, you are either the primary client contact owning all architect-level outcomes, or the senior technical authority providing oversight across the team. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Staff Machine Learning Engineer In Brief We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Part Data Scientist (building models), part Applied Scientist (productionizing models), and part MLE (deploying, maintaining), also known as “Full Stack Data Scientist” – someone who wants to own the end-to-end effectiveness of their real-time models in a live, clinical AI product. Who We Are Bayesian Health ’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What You’ll Do As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you are not satisfied with training and tuning ML models that predict clinical conditions in patients; you also want to own the effectiveness of your model in the real world. In practice, that means you aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty by writing data mapping code, debugging a specific patient case by following patient data as it moves through our AWS services, or improving the timeliness of your model’s predictions by reading and writing production-grade Python and SQL code. Responsibilities Model Prototyping: Develop and tune innovative, new ML models and labeler systems based on deep understanding of clinical use cases and state-of-the-art ML methods. Productionizing: The same models that you develop with production-grade python. Deploying: Identify strategies for improving our production ML-based systems, and write, debug, and deploying production-grade Python code to implement those strategies. MLOps: Build infrastructure that enables ML model development and deployment in production systems. Minimum qualifications Ph.D. in a relevant field plus 3+ years relevant experience, or a relevant Master’s degree and 5+ years experience shipping ML based software products. Experience owning your ML models from prototyping to production. Experience writing production-grade Python and SQL code to implement and evaluate ML models in production systems. Experience using MLOps tools such as SageMaker and MLFlow. Preferred qualifications Experience going 0-1 and shipping high impact AI/ML products. Experience building solutions within healthcare and/or familiarity working with messy health data. Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require. Comfortable interpreting / leveraging state-of-the-art peer-reviewed methods or tools in designing your approach. Excitement for Bayesian’s mission and being a bar raiser so we can accelerate the pace at which we create value. Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: At Dscout , we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. At Dscout, we're building the human-grounded layer that teaches AI to work in the real world and proves it stays aligned there. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. Dscout AI Training & Evals builds human data and evals that show whether AI works for real people. For ten years Dscout has captured how people behave in real context, with consent and scientific rigor. Dscout AI Training & Evals points that engine at AI: consented human behavior and judgment, turned into the training data, evals, and benchmarks AI teams trust. Models ace benchmarks and still surprise people in the wild. A benchmark says how capable a model is. It does not say whether the model works for the person using it, across weeks, in the mess of real life. That gap is where we work. We serve AI researchers, the product builders who ship alongside them, and the research teams who partner with both. We are a new unit inside an established company: live customers, a mature platform (React, Elixir, Python, Swift, Kotlin; SOC 2 and HITRUST certified), a small senior team, and room to build. We work AI-native. Agents write code, evals gate changes, and we aim to do in months what used to take years. A note from our Chief AI Officer & GM. The hardest AI problems show up when a model meets real people, with their tools, their interruptions, and their goals. Our customers need a partner who can design the answer, build it, and ship it fast. Ground Truth sits where deployment meets research: what we learn in the field shapes the science, and the science shapes what we ship. Come build it with us. Why this seat Work on a problem the field has not solved: measuring whether AI works for real people, over real time. Study something most evals do not have: real participants, doing real tasks in their own context. Own the benchmark. You are founding it, not joining a team that has one. Publish. Methods and benchmarks go to the research community, with first authorship on the benchmark. Join a small senior team with direct access to the Head of AI Research and the GM. This is a research-first role focused on questions where the right rubric, benchmark, or method does not yet exist. You will find the gaps, propose bold directions, and take projects from the first hypothesis through experiments and benchmark construction to publication. You will also build: the science has to run inside live customer programs. What you will do Rubrics and QA science Design rubrics and test whether they measure what they claim: validity, reliability, and sensitivity. Measure how reliable human raters are, and when disagreement is noise versus real signal. Calibrate AI judges against real human judgment, and study when they drift away from it. Build quality signals that put evidence behind every data point we ship. Long-horizon, real-user benchmarks Design Dscout’s first benchmark: real users, in real context, over long horizons. Multi-week tasks across tools, not one-shot prompts. Define the protocol, task design, scoring, and release. Work with our delivery team on fieldwork. Work out how to keep a living benchmark honest over time: drift, contamination, difficulty, and what counts as a meaningful change. Write the paper and own the public release. Human judgment as training and eval signal Study when real-world human feedback improves a model and when it adds noise. Explore how preference and judgment data from representative people diffe

jobs.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role We are looking for a Lead Engineer, AI Agent Voice Experience to help build the next generation of AI-powered voice systems for the contact center. In this role, you will work at the intersection of speech, language, and real-time production systems, improving how AI listens, understands, reasons, empathizes, and responds in live customer conversations. You will develop and improve machine learning systems that power voice experiences end to end, including automatic speech recognition, turn detection, agentic workflows, voice evaluation, text to speech, speech-to-speech models, and production optimization. You will partner closely with applied researchers, product managers, designers, forward deployed engineers, and platform engineers to ensure model and system improvements translate into measurable customer and business impact. This role is ideal for someone who is excited by both model quality and production reality: designing rigorous evaluation frameworks, analyzing failure modes, improving latency and robustness, elevating caller interaction experience, and shipping systems that perform reliably at scale in real-time voice environments. Responsibilities Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning systems that power real-time voice experiences, including speech to text turn detection, text to speech, speech to speech, reasoning and structured insight generation. Improve the quality of voice AI systems through error analysis, data curation, metric design, benchmarking, and iterative model improvement, with a strong focus on real-world performance. Build evaluation frameworks for complex voice and agentic systems, measuring metrics such as accuracy, robustness, latency, faithfulness, naturalness, professionalism, task completion, and cost. Diagnose and mitigate failure modes across the voice stack, including transcription errors, hallucinations, tool misuse, prompt brittleness, context drift, and multi-step reasoning breakdowns. Design, implement, and optimize low-latency ML systems that deliver delightful caller experience (e.g., backchanneling, focusing on foreground speaker, interpreting caller’s emotions, responding with empathy). Partner with platform and backend engineers to productionize real-time inference, streaming pipelines, quality monitoring, and continuous model iteration. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, frontend, and backend teams to integrate voice intelligence seamlessly into Cresta’s platform. Mentor engineers, contribute to technical strategy, and help shape the roadmap for Cresta’s voice AI systems. Qualifications we value Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred. 5+ years of experience building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning systems in production. jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
jobs.description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems. You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines. AI is writing your first-draft SQL, analysis, and reporting and you’ve shifted that energy to bringing analysis into the future: building the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that let the team self-serve trustworthy answers. A trusted cross-functional leader. Teammates across functions and levels listen to you. You immerse yourself in the context of their needs and bridge gaps in understanding. Fiercely independent and accountable. You welcome a vague ask with aplomb. A polished dashboard is useful only when it changes what we do. You prioritize the questions that can materially improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue. You’ll define metrics, model the funnel from first touch through paid conversion, and reconcile discrepancies across Snowflake, Segment, Amplitude, GA4, and our ad platforms. Explain what we’re seeing. Why are trials up while paid conversion isn’t? Why are Snowflake and Amplitude disagreeing? Which channel is driving volume but producing low-quality customers? jobs.title: AI Data Scientist
jobs.description: About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the role: We're looking for a data-driven, curious, and collaborative Data Scientist to support product and business decision-making through analytics, experimentation, and applied data science. In this role, you will be responsible for defining new metrics, validating data to generate insights, and owning the end-to-end lifecycle of our data infrastructure—from creating and maintaining Tableau dashboards to building and adapting data fields and tables. Furthermore, as AI capabilities reshape how data teams operate, you'll play an active role in designing and deploying AI-powered agentic workflows to automate these analysis, maintenance, and modeling tasks at scale. Key Responsibilities - Design and deploy AI agent workflows to automate recurring analytical tasks, data summarization, and insight generation pipelines. - Evaluate and integrate LLM-based tools into the data team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for analytical use cases. - Collaborate with product and business teams to define analytical questions, success metrics, and KPIs. - Build and maintain analytics foundation using SQL and dbt, enabling reliable reporting and self-serve analytics. jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.title: Project Lion - Lead Prompt Engineer - United States (Remote, Part-Time)
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Lead Prompt Engineer to guide and manage a team through the full technical migration process, transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. In this role, you will leverage advanced prompt engineering techniques and the client’s internal tools to optimize model performance, ensuring the successful integration and ongoing enhancement of AI systems. As the team lead, you will drive the strategy, mentor junior engineers, and play a key role in shaping the future of our AI-driven solutions. Responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters. Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus. Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts. Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked. Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall. Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final. Requirement: Language Skills : Native fluency in English. Location: Must be based in United States. Education : Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field. Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 7 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning. Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools. Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision. Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Optional / Preferred Skills: Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API. Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering. Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows. Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic. jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist / ML Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a product-minded applied data scientist or engineer to turn raw operational data into products that measurably improve how our customers make decisions and run their businesses. Which label you carry matters less to us than whether customers end up better off. This is not a research-only role, nor a service-oriented internal analytics position—and it is not a role for a model builder alone. We want an owner: someone who frames the problem, learns the domain, builds the data when it doesn't exist, ships the model, and stays with it until customers are acting on it and can measure the reward. The road runs through data engineering; deployment and testing are part of delivery, not a handoff. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, and measurable inside a real product. Whether you came to this work through statistics, software, analytics, or data engineering, you have a strong bias toward shipping. What You'll Do From Raw Data to Better Decisions Own the Outcome: Take an ambiguous customer problem, decide whether ML is even the right answer, build it, and stay with it until customers are acting on it. Learn the Domain: Get fluent in the semantics of how our customers operate—what a route, a crew, or a service history actually means. A model that is accurate but wrong about the domain creates nothing. Build the Data You Need: When the features don't exist, create them in Snowflake and dbt rather than waiting for someone else to. Prove It and Make It Felt Make the Value Legible: Decide how a prediction reaches the customer so they understand it, trust it, and act on it—then report realised impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. Measure Honestly: Define offline and online evaluation for model quality, drift, and reliability, and design the A/B tests or causal analyses that prove a feature improved customer outcomes. Deliver Ship and Operate: Deployment, testing, versioning, monitoring, and drift detection. Delivery is part of the job, not a handoff. Embed with Product: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to put ML inside real product workflows—and say clearly when ML isn't the answer. Who We Are The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions, not by whether the model shipped. Closer to the Data and the Customer: You'd rather spend a week understanding what the data means than a week tuning a model. You know the domain is the hard part. A Multi-Disciplinary Operator: You'll chase down the data yourself when it isn't ready, and build the pipeline if that's what delivery requires. You prioritise usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you have shipped a model you are proud of, we want to hear from you! HOW WE WORK We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next model faster to ship. The leverage is in the verification: the backtests, eval scaffolding, and data checks that make generated work safe to trust. What You'll Bring Experience: 5+ years in applied data science, ML engineering, or data engineering that included owning models in production—including at least one model you built and shipped into a real product. B2B SaaS experience is a strong plus. Technical Core: Strong Python and applied ML libraries for tabular problems (scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, statsmodels or Prophet). Solid SQL expertise is required. ML & Modeling Depth: Depth in supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation, or optimisation. You have modelled messy operational data, not benchmark datasets. Data & Delivery: You build the data you need and ship what you build—dbt and Snowflake modelling, feature pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection. We're on AWS.

jobs.title: GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM)
jobs.description: About the Job: AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data. Responsibilities: Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains. Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems. Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations. Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact. Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling. Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls. Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like. Qualifications: 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs. Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe. Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale. Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs. Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority. Nice to Have Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts. Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML-assisted or LLM-assisted matching and cleansing. Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2. Pay: Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4: Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $152,900 - $210,210 ** Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $137,600 - $189,200 ** Zone 3: All other US locations - $129,900 - $178,640* * LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust

Analytical rigor: Fluency in SQL or a BI tool such as Hex, Mode, or Looker, with comfort tying operational work to conversion, velocity, and cost. Funnel instinct: Real operating experience with lead routing, calling operations, script and cadence testing, and agent coaching. Cross-team coordination: Ability to hold many channels at once — from AI callers to affiliates to market launch — without losing the thread. Strong communication: Excellent English communication skills to work daily with US-based teams and partners. jobs.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress. How we work Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated: Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress. If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit. Want to learn more? Read and listen: We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take. About this role GiveDirectly gives cash directly to people living in poverty and in emergencies. Both depend on the same question: did this person live in this place, at this time? We ask it when we target the poorest households, and when a disaster displaces a community overnight. Location records held by Mobile Network Operators (MNO) can help us estimate an answer to this question at scale. We work with MNOs so they can infer, from their own records, whether a subscriber was resident in a target area over a defined period. Robust residence location inference from MNO data requires in-depth analytical work, and the methods we design have to run on an operator's systems - most often implemented by their engineers - under strict data protection and confidentiality rules. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to progress our work on location inference from MNO data, and to make it repeatable. If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com . Why Now? jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements. Equal Opportunity All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, SRE and Production Engineering - DGX Cloud
jobs.description: NVIDIA DGX Cloud builds and operates large-scale GPU infrastructure for AI workloads. We are looking for Software Engineers with SRE or Production Engineering experience who have worked hands-on with bare-metal NVIDIA systems. This team builds the software and operational tooling that moves GPU capacity from installed hardware to production service supporting an IaaS production environment of BMaaS, VMaaS. What you’ll be doing: Build automation for bare-metal provisioning, hardware validation, firmware and software upgrades, repair, and cluster lifecycle management. Develop tools that interact with BMC and Redfish interfaces to monitor hardware health, manage server state, and assist recovery workflows. Handle and advance NVIDIA NVL72 systems and BlueField-3 or later DPUs throughout cloud partner and on-premises environments. Diagnose failures across servers, DPUs, GPU systems, CPU systems, networking, Linux, and Kubernetes; turn recurring issues into automated detection and repair. Define validation and handoff criteria so new capacity enters production safely and consistently. Take part in on-call duties, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up to implement permanent solutions. Work with hardware, networking, platform, data center operations, and partner teams to resolve issues across ownership boundaries. What we need to see: 12+ years building software for or operating production infrastructure, including substantial hands-on bare-metal experience. Strong Go or Python skills, with a record of delivering production automation and services. Direct experience with BMC and Redfish in server provisioning, health inspection, power management, or fault diagnosis. Practical experience working directly with NVIDIA GPU hardware, such as NVL72 systems, and BlueField-3 or newer DPUs. Experience with Linux, firmware and driver management, network boot, and the server lifecycle from initial provisioning through repair. Experience managing production reliability through on-call duties, incident response, observability, and durable solutions. Ability to debug failures across hardware, host operating systems, networking, and distributed services. Clear communication and demonstrated ownership of problems that span multiple teams. BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a practical setting. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience operating BlueField DPUs in DPU mode, including host-to-DPU connectivity and lifecycle debugging, with DPU or equivalent experience considered. Background with NVLink, InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, or GPU cluster performance validation. Experience building safe, repeatable workflows for rack-scale bringup, firmware upgrades, hardware replacement, and customer handoff. Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, Argo CD, SLOs, and fleet-wide automation. At NVIDIA , you’ll help make next-generation AI infrastructure production-ready at scale! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 170,000 CAD – 220,000 CAD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 7, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Psycholoog // online
jobs.description: LMcare gaat de strijd aan met de wachtlijsten in de GGZ. Dankzij onze succesvolle FIT-behandelmethode, kunnen we de wachtlijsten kort houden. Met een doorverwijzing van de huisarts kunnen cliënten de volgende dag al een afspraak plannen met onze triageverpleegkundige. Hierop volgt een kort, intensief traject via videobellen. Alles via een beveiligde verbinding in onze app. Psycholoog bij LMcare Voor een cliënt is een flexibele agenda fijn, maar voor jou als behandelaar ook. Jij bepaalt hoeveel cliënten je behandelt en wanneer je dat doet. Zo heb je de regie over je eigen work/life balance. Werken vanuit Bali, Turkije, Colombia of Italië? Fantastisch! Het enige wat je écht nodig hebt is een stabiele internetverbinding en een rustige werkplek. Wat voor ons telt, is dat je voldoening uit je werk haalt en blij wordt van het bieden van de best mogelijke hulp aan mensen. Hulp van een buddy Wil jij een kleine en overzichtelijke caseload die je intensief behandelt? Met de steun van een deskundige buddy aan je zij? Dan koppelen wij je graag aan een ervaren regiebehandelaar die jou helpt bij het kwalitatief goed behandelen van cliënten. Het is fijn om advies in te winnen bij een collega. Online werken bij LMcare Cliënten behandel je online via je computer, tablet of smartphone; Kleine, overzichtelijke caseload en daardoor sterke therapeutische link; Een toegewezen buddy - een vast aanspreekpunt om mee te sparren; MDO’s met medebehandelaars doen we ook online; LMcare Academy: ons kennisinstituut over de do's & don'ts van online behandelen in de GGZ; Maandelijks werkoverleg + lunch & learn sessies met het hele team. Naast online werken, zien we elkaar ook fysiek met de jaarlijkse studiereis (Stockholm, Scheveningen, Brussel, Berlijn, Parijs), studiedagen en spontane borrels! Vereisten voor kwaliteit Uiteraard willen we de kwaliteit van onze zorg op hoog niveau aanbieden. Daarom stellen we een aantal belangrijke eisen aan jou als medebehandelaar: Opleiding tot psycholoog (WO) Aantoonbaar CGT- en/of EMDR kennis Minstens 5 jaar behandelervaring in de ambulante SGGZ Handigheid in het werken met digitale media Bereidheid om minstens 24 uur per week aan onze cliënten te besteden Zorg voor onze collega's Bij LMcare ben jij als behandelaar onze topprioriteit. Samen bepalen we per maand hoeveel uren jij gaat werken. Deze uren zet je in onze gedeelde agenda. Overdag, of liever ’s avonds wanneer de kinderen slapen? Alles is mogelijk. De cliënt boekt een intake in overleg met de triagist en de vervolgafspraken plannen jullie vervolgens samen in. Behandelen volgens FIT-method, uniek in Nederland Wetenschappelijk onderzoek bewijst het succes van meerdere behandelsessies per week. Als behandelgesprekken elkaar snel opvolgen, blijven informatie, inzichten en oefeningen beter hangen bij cliënten. Dit werkt ontzettend motiverend voor de cliënt én de behandelaar. Bij LMcare behandelen we daarom succesvol volgens onze zelf ontwikkelde FIT-method. FIT staat voor Frequent, Intensive Therapy. Door onze ervaring met de FIT-method, weten we dat een sGGZ-traject bij LMcare gemiddeld binnen 4 maanden succesvol afgerond kan zijn. Terwijl het landelijk gemiddelde op 8 maanden ligt. Hiermee versnellen we de doorstroom van cliënten en dragen we ons steentje bij aan het verkorten van de wachtlijsten. Iets voor jou? LMcare is een no-nonsense GGZ-instelling die psychische zorg voor volwassenen in een nieuw jasje steekt. Laagdrempelig en zonder stoffige bureaucratie. We werken volledig volgens de Wtza, schakelen snel en hebben een open bedrijfscultuur. Alle behandelaars werken op afstand vanuit verschillende landen en continenten, maar zijn een hecht team. Werken bij de grootste online GGZ-instelling van Nederland: 30 WO-basispsychologen en 30 regiebehandelaars. meer dan 250 consulten per dag. Reeds 4300+ cliënten behandeld. Klinkt als iets voor jou? We maken graag kennis met je! Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. argenx is looking for a Senior Director level Head of Global Labeling and Labeling Operations to lead and evolve its global labeling function in support of the continued development, registration, and successful commercialization of its existing and future marketed products. Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities: This individual is a senior regulatory leader responsible for defining and executing global labeling strategy across the product lifecycle. The role serves as the company’s senior subject-matter expert on labeling strategy, bringing deep experience translating clinical evidence into scientifically substantiated labeling proposals to inform labeling strategy and negotiations with global regulatory agencies, in particular the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The person in this role is a key member of the global regulatory leadership team and partners closely with Clinical Development, Technical Operations/Device, Safety, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, Legal, and regional Regulatory colleagues. This leader ensures labeling considerations inform development and evidence-generation decisions, supports scientifically sound product differentiation, and maintains consistent, compliant labeling across markets. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, including direct responsibility for selected high-priority programs. This individual will lead and develop internal FTEs, manage consultants and external resources, and evolve the labeling function through the strategic implementation of a Target Product Label process and continued development of the internal Label Working Group and Global Labeling Committee. The key responsibilities for this individual are: Define the global labeling vision, priorities, and strategy across development-stage and marketed products. Serve as the senior regulatory authority for labeling strategy and lead preparation for and execution of FDA labeling negotiations, in partnership with the US Regulatory Lead. Ensure labeling strategies are integrated with global regulatory strategy, clinical development, safety evaluation, commercialization, and lifecycle planning. Provide senior leadership with clear recommendations on labeling opportunities, evidence requirements, regulatory risks, and negotiation trade-offs. Build and develop a high-performing global labeling organization, with accountability for internal FTEs, consultants, and external service providers. Your primary areas of focus are: Global Labeling Strategy and Lifecycle Management Lead the development and maintenance of Company Core Data Sheets (CCDS), US Prescribing Information (USPI), and EU product information, in partnership with regional Regulatory colleagues. Establish scientifically substantiated labeling positions for initial registrations, new indications, formulations/product presentations, patient populations, safety updates, and other lifecycle changes. Ensure proposed labeling is supported by the totality of available evidence, with clear identification of evidence gaps and potential regulatory challenges. Provide strategic oversight of regional and country labeling, ensuring alignment with core labeling while appropriately managing justified local differences. Pa

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role Join a data infrastructure and analytics team building a platform that turns information from many sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform end to end, from architecture and ingestion through production operations. What You'll Do Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows. Ingest data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, with rate limiting and robust failure handling. Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar tools. Build event-driven systems with messaging or task queues, including retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay. Preserve original payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform them with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers. Implement idempotent upserts and safe retries to prevent duplicate records and data corruption. Define data contracts, automated validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures. Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction. What We're Looking For At least 5 years building and operating production data platforms across multiple sources, from architecture through ongoing operations. Production experience with workflow orchestration, including dependencies, retries, and failure recovery. Airflow is preferred; Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or comparable tools are relevant. Hands-on production experience with dbt and Google Cloud Platform. Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with asyncio, aiohttp, HTTPX, or similar tools. Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading. Experience with event-driven systems, messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, and recovery from failures. Experience implementing data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, automated validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring. Web scraping, entity resolution, data enrichment, BigQuery, or Dataform experience is helpful, as is building platforms from scratch in a small team. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $120,000 to $160,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Remote within the United States. New York-based candidates are welcome, but New York residence is not required. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Revit
jobs.description: Revit is one of the brands in the Belkins group of companies. In 3 years, we’ve grown to a team of 25+ people located all over the world, and so far we’ve made a positive impact on more than 150 clients who trusted our team with their growth and outbound (emails, LinkedIn, cold calling). At Revit, we show up every day because we love selling ideas, creating new business relationships, solving challenges that might seem impossible, and getting results where others couldn’t — so that like-minded clients who trust us with their outbound and growth can become our years-long partners. With more extensive support from the other companies in the Belkins group, our 2027 goal is to grow 2x in size and find a way to keep scaling while keeping quality high across the board — from having the best people on the team to onboarding the right clients who match our values and value proposition. Back in 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast forward to today, and we’ve transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. Among our successes are ambitious start-ups like Revit , which have evolved into standalone powerhouses, as well as innovative products such as Folderly . This is not a place for everyone, but if you’re looking for a world-class culture and an opportunity to grow, build your career, and make an impact, you’re likely to enjoy being part of Revit and building the future together with us! And now we’re looking for a Head of Sales : someone who wants to own the number, not just manage the team, and who’d rather be on the call than read about it in a report. The role Revit sells outbound, so our own sales team is measured by the same thing we promise clients: real conversations that turn into real deals. You’ll take over the sales team and the number behind it, with one clear goal for 2027 — help us grow 2x: Double MRR by the end of 2027; Double our close rate; Actively support marketing as we double the pipeline. You’ll work side by side with Nick, our Co-Founder/CEO, the core team across all verticals, and the other brands in Belkins Group. What you’ll do: Making 3 AEs better every week. You’ll do call reviews, give feedback, sit in on deals, and jump in to close when it matters. Owning the number. You’ll handle MRR, forecasts, and monthly plans, and know where we stand and why before anyone asks. Building the system. You’ll build a sales process that’s clear enough for a new AE to follow, with data that shows exactly where deals get stuck. Growing the close rate. You’ll find where we lose deals between the first call and the signature, and fix it. Designing KPIs and incentives that reward the results we actually want. Being marketing’s closest partner. You’ll shape ICPs and messaging together, so a bigger pipeline turns into revenue, not just a fuller calendar. Scaling the team as we grow, including bringing in fractional AEs when it makes sense. What you bring: A sales leader who wants to own our growth. You’re still hands-on and still on calls, and you can build a team and a process around you. Sales leadership: 1–2+ years leading a team of 3–4+ people, with numbers that show what changed while you led it. Digital marketing services: agency-side experience, not a SaaS/product or software development company. US market: you’ve sold to US clients and know how they buy. Close rate: ideally 15%+, or a clear story behind your numbers. Revenue ownership: planning, forecasting, and explaining MRR. Sales process: you’ve built or run a structured process and improved it with data. High pace: you get things done and are driven by results. Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust! About the role Do you want to build the internal products a revenue team actually runs on, and do it with AI agents as your default tool? You're a builder, closer to a founding product engineer for the revenue org. You build the internal products Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success run on. Every build is product work. What's the problem, who has it, did they adopt the fix. You'll feel the difference between shipping something and shipping something people use. You won't get a technical spec. Your work is visible immediately. Pipeline data, renewal risk, and partner health all reach the executive team. You'll see the impact of what you ship in the room, not three layers removed from it. We measure success by whether people use what you build. A tool nobody uses is a signal to find out why, and you'll own that follow-up. Improve the agents already running for the revenue team and add new skills, integrations, and autonomous workflows with measurable outcomes. Build sophisticated marketing tools that show what's driving the pipeline and 10x Marketing's output. Build internal sales tools: post-call follow-ups, demo environments, research, prospecting and enrichment pipelines, competitive battlecards, and pipeline data leadership can trust. Build the partner and customer operations workflows: health reports that run themselves, and the onboarding, renewal, and expansion workflows that make growth easier to see. As Internship - Socio-Economic Analysis of Satellite Communications for Regional Railways you will support a strategic study on the use of Governmental Satellite Communications (GovSatCom) for regional railway lines across Europe. In particular you will focus on assessing the technical, economic, and societal benefits of satellite communications for railway operations, compared with alternative telecommunications solutions such as public mobile networks, private wireless networks, and fixed telecommunications infrastructures. This internship offers the opportunity to contribute to an innovative European study at the intersection of railway digitalization, satellite communications, and transport economics.
